hero.title: Big data & full-stack background, now focused on making AI actually land
hero.subtitle: Started out as a big data engineer, worked across Java and Python full-stack, and dove deep into LLM apps. Now I'm seriously working out how enterprises can put AI to good use, and which workflows Agents should truly reshape.

about.p1: My engineering roots are in big data — from 2021 to 2023 I worked as a big data engineer at Jike, deep in Java and massive data pipelines. That's where I learned what good engineering really means.
about.p2: Then I moved into Python and full-stack development, and dove headfirst into LLM apps. From backend to product, from tuning models to wiring up workflows, I grew convinced that the way we build software is being redefined by AI. (Off the clock, I'm also a vibe coder having a great time.)
about.p3: Since 2026, I've focused on how AI actually lands in the enterprise — rethinking which workflows Agents should reshape, and sharing what I figure out along the way. Good engineering was never about showing off; it's about getting genuinely useful things into more hands.
